Stop. Take a listen. You’ll hear it everywhere. The double beat. The one-two cadence that propels us all from deep within. Thump-Thump. Goes the heart. The boxer
throws the powerful one-two—boxing’s most feared combination. Two quick claps of the hands and dancers prepare for perfection. Snap your fingers two times and watch
as everyone around gets ready to move. Why do rock legends tap the microphone twice before melting your face? What makes a thoroughbred’s muscles respond when
it hears two clicks from a jockey’s mouth? This is no mere coincidence. The double beat lives on a deeper level. An emotional level. It’s a universal tribal-like connection.
It’s everywhere. And we’ve followed it for over 40 years. Always building to it. It’s what drove us to make the MX-5 Miata, the best-selling roadster of all time.
The MAZDASPEED3, one of the fastest front-wheel-drive cars on the planet. And the rotary-powered RX-8, a sports car like no other. It’s what stirs our soul. And what
led us to create the 2008 North American Truck of the Year. The innovative, 7-passenger Mazda CX-9 crossover SUV. We’ll never stop listening. Zoom-Zoom. Forever.

Its capacity for fun rivals its capacity for passengers. On the open highway—or even in a crowded parking lot—the spacious, 7-passenger Mazda CX-9’s crisp
handling is remarkably rewarding. Simply put, it doesn’t “feel” like a big SUV. Nor does it handle like one. In striking contrast to the slow, clumsy feel of many SUVs, the
Mazda CX-9’s fun-to-drive ride dynamics are notably responsive and agile—yet also exceptionally stable and comfortable. The exhilarating difference starts with the
CX-9’s precise, power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering system with engine-speed-sensing variable assist. Plus a refined 4-wheel independent suspension system.
At both ends, hefty stabilizer bars help minimize body roll. Up front, MacPherson struts ensure excellent tire-to-road contact. While at the rear, a sophisticated
multilink system promotes accurate wheel placement and surefooted handling. The end result is a crossover SUV that takes full advantage of Mazda’s suspension-
tuning expertise. Delivering an exhilarating combination of confidence-inspiring road manners and a comfortable, well-disciplined ride for the whole family.

Of its seven seats, the best one is arguably behind the wheel. Unlike typical SUVs with three-row seating, the Mazda CX-9’s cockpit was actually inspired
by world-class sport sedans. And the difference is instantly apparent. For example, a heated, 8-way power-adjustable driver’s seat is standard on both the Touring
and Grand Touring. And available on the Sport. Also standard is a leather-wrapped steering wheel that tilts and telescopes to help provide a more comfortable
driving position. Both of which contribute to a cockpit with the confidence-inspiring fit of a custom-tailored suit. Other standard interior features are equally well
tailored to your expectations. Including an AM/FM/CD stereo system with six speakers and an auxiliary-audio input jack for your favorite MP3 player. Bluetooth®
hands-free phone capability. Power windows, mirrors and door locks. Plus cruise control and a trip computer. Helping ensure that your CX-9 remains a perfect fit for
years to come are state-of-the-art options. Like a SIRIUS Satellite Radio®. * A Bose® 10-speaker Centerpoint® Surround Sound audio system. Even a voice-activated,
touch-screen navigation system and rearview camera. In fact, when you think about it, it’s a cockpit that’s pretty much thought of everything.
1 2 3
1 A Three-Zone Automatic Climate-Control System, standard on all CX-9 models, allows you to independently adjust cooling and heating functions for the driver’s,
front passenger’s and rear passengers’ zones. An outside-temperature display is also included. 2 Heated And Power-Adjustable, Leather-Trimmed Front Seats
are standard on both the Touring and Grand Touring. The heated driver’s seat also provides an 8-way power-adjustable design, including lumbar support. The heated front
passenger’s seat features a 4-way power-adjustable design. 3 A Driver’s Seat With Position Memory is also standard on the Grand Touring. This feature allows you
to store and access up to three customized driving positions. Then, at the touch of a button, it automatically adjusts all eight settings to the exact presets you desire.
* reception requires a subscription. Available only in the U.S., except Alaska and Hawaii.

It’s never been so easy to give everyone their own space. Mazda CX-9 serves up one of the most spacious, versatile and comfortable cabins of any
crossover SUV on the planet. In fact, thanks to its purposefully long, 113.2-inch wheelbase, it readily accommodates seven adults with remarkable ease. And
because the CX-9’s large rear doors can swing open up to 72º to create an extra-wide opening, entering and exiting are quick and easy. Even access to 3rd-row
seating is more convenient—the result of an ingenious “tilt and slide” rear-access mechanism. No gymnastics required. And once inside, you’ll discover a host
of other family-oriented advantages. Like ample legroom for both 2nd- and 3rd-row adult passengers. Dual LATCH child-safety-seat anchors and tethers in the
2nd-row seat. Two 3rd-row storage bins designed to hold electronic games and controllers. A surprising abundance of cargo room behind the 3rd-row seat. Not to
mention eight cup holders and four 1-liter bottle holders. Which means the whole family will get a lot more out of the CX-9. Because we put so much more into it.
1
1 From People Mover To Cargo Hauler In Seconds. In people mover mode, you’ll find a generous 17.2 cu ft of cargo space behind the 3rd-row seat plus
a hidden, under-floor storage box with nearly 2 cu ft of space. A quick tug on the 3rd-row release straps quickly folds down the CX-9’s 50/50 split rear seatback to
provide 48.4 cu ft of cargo space. Fold down the 2nd-row’s 60/40 split seatback, and the CX-9 rewards you with a whopping 100.7 cu ft of total cargo space. And all
without the hassle of removing any headrests. 2 An Ingenious Rear-Access Latch operates easily with a single hand. It automatically tilts and slides the
CX-9’s 2nd-row seat forward to provide far easier access to 3rd-row seating. 3 The 2nd-Row Seat Features A Reclining Seatback and provides nearly
5 inches of forward/backward travel for greater passenger comfort and extra legroom. 4 A Power Rear Liftgate (Open/Close) With Remote Control
is available on both the Touring and Grand Touring to help make loading and unloading more convenient, from top to bottom.

Passively and actively, it puts your family’s safety first. Painstakingly engineered into every Mazda CX-9 is a cutting-edge arsenal of passive and active
safety systems. Plus the added peace of mind that comes from knowing your family is well protected in a crossover SUV that earned Five Stars—the highest rating
possible—in government frontal and side-impact crash tests.* Some CX-9 safety features are both high-tech and ingenious. Like Roll Stability Control. Dynamic
Stability Control.† An integral Traction Control System. And, of course, front side-impact air bags plus side-impact air curtains for all three rows.‡ Others are both easy
to see and appreciate. Like an automatic Tire-Pressure Monitoring System and 3-point seat belts for all seven seating positions. But all are standard—not extra-cost
options. As are many of the CX-9’s unseen safety features. Including side-impact door beams and front and rear crumple zones. And a “crushable” brake pedal that
folds away in an accident to minimize the chance of a serious ankle or leg injury. In short, the CX-9 was engineered to be among the safest vehicles in its class.
1 2 3
1 Advanced Dual Front Air Bags, Front Side-Impact Air Bags And Side-Impact Air Curtains‡ with rollover protection for all three rows of
seating are standard on every CX-9. All to provide an added margin of protection in the case of a collision or rollover. 2 Four-Wheel Ventilated Disc Brakes
With ABS And EBD are standard equipment on the CX-9. Four-wheel ventilated disc brakes with an Anti-lock Brake System promote linear, fade-resisting stopping
power. While Electronic Brakeforce Distribution automatically, and more effectively, regulates braking power between front and rear axles. 3 Mazda’s “Triple H”
Construction adds extra steel reinforcements to critical CX-9 body areas, enhancing the vehicle’s structural integrity and impact protection as well as its handling.

Enjoy a power trip that’s as responsible as it is responsive. Only Mazda could engineer a 7-passenger crossover SUV this innovative. And this
satisfying. One that delivers more responsive performance plus a responsible 22 mpg highway/16 mpg city.* One that’s more nimble, more exhilarating and
more fun. One that, in every imaginable way, is definitely more you. Especially when it comes to what’s under the hood. No ordinary propulsion system here.
Instead, the CX-9 boasts a highly advanced, perfectly matched powertrain. With a 273-hp all-aluminum 3.7-liter DOHC V6 engine that features 24 valves,
variable valve timing, electronic throttle control and a robust 270 lb-ft of torque. Plus a sophisticated 6-speed Sport AT automatic transmission that provides
all the extra control—and fun—of a manual-shift mode. There’s even an available Active Torque Split AWD system that automatically optimizes vehicle traction
and control—regardless of changing road and weather conditions. Which gives your family even more reasons to love the Mazda CX-9. Body and soul.

The closer you look, the farther away other SUVs appear. It’s not some trick. Or an optical illusion. The rich textures, quality materials
and precision craftsmanship you’ll find in abundance throughout the Mazda CX-9 Grand Touring are the real deal. And they create real and
dramatic points of difference between the CX-9 and ordinary crossovers. As well as a remarkably satisfying driving environment. Insightful
touches abound. Like elegant double stitching. Graceful “floating” door grips. And the supple comfort of leather-trimmed and heated front
seats. Note, too, how your entry is uniquely acknowledged by the Grand Touring’s indirect blue lighting on the center console and door panels.
How its red-on-black electroluminescent gauges reward your every glance. How its sweeping interior accents evoke the visual harmony of
finely crafted furniture. And even how effectively the CX-9’s double door seals and body frame—insulated with sound-deadening foam in
22 strategic points—help preserve a calm, quiet cabin. One test drive, in fact, and other crossovers are a distant memory.
1 2 3
1 Mazda’s Advanced Keyless Entry & Start System is standard on the Grand Touring and available on the Touring. It conveniently allows you to remotely lock or unlock the CX-9’s
doors, operate the power windows and rear liftgate, and even keylessly start the engine. 2 Bluetooth® Hands-Free Phone Capability, standard on all CX-9 models, enables you to
make and receive calls, access voice mail messages—and more—via simple voice commands and your Bluetooth-compatible cell phone. 3 A Blind Spot Monitoring System* is standard
on the Grand Touring. The system uses a pair of radar-based, rear-facing sensors to detect vehicles in both left and right rear blind spots. If a vehicle is detected, a warning light appears in
the appropriate outside mirror. And when the driver signals a lane change into a lane that’s occupied, the warning light begins blinking and a warning chime also sounds.
* Always check your mirrors. Be aware of the traffic around you.
